translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Timoteo nade-gusad Pabloba, degi, Silasba

Pablo Derbe-neggweburse, degi, Listra-neggweburse modapsunnad. Agi dule-wargwen Bab-Jesúsba-naid mai dakdapid. A-dulede Timoteoye-nugad. Ade e-nan Judiod, Bab-Jesúsba-nue-naimogad. E-babdi Griego-dolad.
Gwenadgan Listraginmalad, degi, Iconioginmalad, bela yeer Timoteogi sunmakedbimalad.
Pablo Timoteo-nidbigualid, aga abgan-duku-siked-igar imakega imaksad, adi Judiomar mer Timoteogi akar sogmalagar, ar bela wismalad, e-bab Griego-duled.
Pablo, Silas-ebo belagwapa neggwebur-irba gwenadganga sognadap-gusmalad, igi Jesús-nuggi-barmilesmalad, degi, Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-e-idumalad Jerusaléngi-bukmalad, Judiosurmaladga igar-mesismala.
Degisoggu, Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad ulubgi Bab-Jesús-igargi gannaledmarsunnad, degine, bane-bane Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad mergumai-gusad.
Pablo neg-burgan daksadba Macedonia-yarse naded
Pablo, Silas-ebo Frigia-yalaganba, degi, Galacia-yalaganba nadmarsun, ar ade Bab Dummad Burba Nued Asia-yargi Pablo Bab-Jesús-gaya-burbagi sunmaked gwen imaksasulid.
Pablo, Silas-ebo Misia-yar-abingunaidse modapmargu, Bitinia-yarse dogoye sogsamalanad, degi-inigwele, Bab-Jesús-Burba-Nued a-yarse dogega gwen imaksasurbalid.
Degisoggu, Misia-yargi bakar nasmargu, Troasse modapmarsunnad.
A-neggweburgi Pablo mutikba gabdakalid, neg-burgan dakalid, dule-wargwen Macedoniagined, e-asabin gwichi, egi wilenai, ega sognai: “Macedonia-yarse be dage, anmar-bendakega.”
Pablo we neg-burgan daksad-sorba, yog anmar Macedonia-yarse naesokarsunnad. Ar anmarga Bab Dummad nue oyos anmar itomalad, anmarse gornai, “An-gaya-burba-nuedgi we-neggweburmarse be sunmaknamarye.”
Degisoggu, urgi anmar Troas-akar inik-baksa Samotracia-dupse nade-gusad. A-banedgi geb anmar Neápolisse omodapsunnad.
Neápolisgi geb anmar nadbalid, Filiposse. A-neggweburgi Romayob neg-selemaid, degi, Filipos-neggwebur Macedonia-yargi bur neg-nug-nikaa simogad. Agi anmar ibbigbasaar megialid.
Lidia, Bab-Jesúsba nagusad

Obunnoged-iba mosgu, anmar neggweburgi bangudmalad, diwar-gakase anmar nadmarsunnad, bia gusgu Bab-Dummadse-golega nad-damaladse. Agi anmar sigisgua, Bab-Jesús-gaya-burba-nuedgi omegan-ambikunonimaladga sunmakdemalad.

Ome-wargwen, Lidia-nugad, Tiatira-neggweburgined, anmar-itosii-gusmogad. A-omede mor-nued suir-akwagii-dakleged ukedid. Lidiade nue Bab Dummadse gordimosoggu, Bab-Jesús e-gwage ebunonisunnad, adi Pablo-ibmar-soged abingaegar.

Lidia Bab-Jesús-abingassoggu, Bab-Jesús-digi-ogleged-igar imaksasunnad, degi, e-neg-yaurginmalad degi-imaksamogad. A-sorba Lidia anmargi wilenaigusad, anmarga sogded: “Nue-Bab-Jesúsba-nai be an-dakele, an-negse be obunnodamardo.” Degisoggu, e-neggi-meged anmar-imaksasundo.
Pablo, Silas-ebo Filiposgi eskaryagi metemalad

Ibagwengi, anmar Bab Dummadse gornadapmargu, bunagwa-wargwen, igarba anmar-abingualid. A-bunagwade nelegwad, niaburba-nikadid, degine, dule-baid-maiga gudibalid. A-bunorde idu-ibmar-guoed-sogedgi e-ibmalaga mani-dummad onodiid.
We-bunagwade Pablo-sorba, degi, anmar-sorba nai, binnasur gordani-gualid, sogdani: “We-dulemar Bab-Dummad-Bur-Dummadidga-arbamalad-dulemalad, bemarga abonoleged-igargi wemar sunmakdanimalad.”

Degi bane-bane bunagwa anmar-sorba gordigusoggu, Pablo sae-itoargusad. Pablo aibilis imaksagu, niaburba-bunagwagi-maidga sogded: “Jesucristo-nuggi an bega soged, bunagwagi-be-maid emispinne be nodasun.” Niaburba bunagwagi yog noar imaksad.
Bunagwa-e-ibmala bar mani-dummad ega onogosur dakarmargu, Pablo, degi, Silas-gasmalad, geb dummaganse senonimalad, igar-itoged-negse.
Igar-nabiromalad-asabin ogwisnonimargu, sogdemalad: “We-dulemar, Judio-dorgan, na-e-damaladba anmar-odurdakdanimalad, degisoggu, anmar-dulemar-ichodanimardo.
Ar anmardi Roma-dulemarsoggu, e-damalad geg anmar abingamalad, degi, geg anmar eba damarbalid.”
Degisoggu, dule-bukidar Pablo, degi, Silasgi gwisguarmarsunnad, ese uludmarsunnad. Igar-nabiromalad ei-mor esuega imaksamalad, geb suargi bibyoged-igar ega mesismarbalid.
Pablo, degi, Silas-sabsur-sarsosmalad-sorba, eskaryagi metemalad. Eskarya-dakedga igar uksamalad: “Nue we-dulemar-dakoye, abakalegi begi wakinnalirye.”
Eskarya-daked degi-ega-igar-uklesgu, gatik eskarya-yaba bur-dogaledse Pablo, degi, Silas-odossunnad. Aginbali, cepo-yaba Pablo, degi, Silas-e-nag ise-odoar imaksabalid.
Nega-gabigwenadba Pablo, Silas-ebogwa Bab Dummadse gorbukwa, degi, namakar Bab-Dummad-nug odummobukwa-gusmalad. Deun dule-baigan-eskaryagi-mellesimalad, Pablo, degi, Silas-itobukwa-gusmarmogad.
Degidgine, ukiar neg-obandur nagunonigu, neg-giglimakded, eskarya e-maliganse-bakar giglimakdemogad, eskarya-yawagakmar bela argaded, degi, dulemar-eskoro-dubgi-atinbukmalad bela achikdemalad.
Eskarya-daked atakargu, yawagakmar-argasii dakargu, eskaryagi-mellebukmalad wakitemarye bialinsoggu, na dukin oburgwegala e-espunyar onos imaksad.
Pablo degi-daksagu, binnasur eskarya-dakedse goted, ega sogded: “¡Mer na be dukin oburgwe, bela amba anmar wegi bukmalad!”
Eskarya-daked gwallu egichisgu, eskarya-yaba dogdegu, ber-dobedba wawanmakded, Pablo-asabin, degi, Silas-asabin, yokorgi sindigar sigdapid.
Eskarya-daked, Pablo, degi, Silas magadba onosgu, egi wilenagusad, ega sogded: “Dummagan, ¿igi an saele, geb an abonolesale?”
Pablo, degi, Silas, abin-imakdemar: “Dummad-Jesucristogi mer be bengu, ar degiir, geb be abonolegoed, degi, be-neg-yaurginmalad amba abonolemogoed.”
Agi Pablo, Silas-ebo Bab-Jesús-gaya-burba-nuedgi eskarya-dakedga, degi, bela e-neggi-bukmaladga sunmakdemarsunnad.
Eskarya-daked aka a-mutikidgi Pablo, degi, Silas-naibigusmalad ega nue enuksad. Eskarya-daked, degine, e-neg-yaurginmalad bela Bab-Jesús-digi-ogleged-igar a-mutikidgi imaksamarsunnad.
A-sorba eskarya-daked, na e-negse, Pablo, degi, Silas-sesa-gusad, geb degi masgi oguchabalid. Eskarya-daked, degi, e-neg-yaurginmalad Bab-Jesús-bengusur-gunonimalad-ular, bela weligwar itosmalad.
Neg-oibosgu, wakudar-yalaba igar-nabiromalad suar-ibmala barmismalad, adi eskarya-dakedga sogegar, we-dulemar be onogoye.
Agi eskarya-daked Pabloga sokar: “Igar-nabiromalad-dummagan anga igar-uksado, be-onomalagar. Degisoggu, akarsundo bemar boni-gwen-niksurmardo, bemar namarsundo.”

Pablo suar-ibmalaga sokar: “Anmar, emide Roma-dulemar-gue-inigwele, igar-nabiromalad dulemar-bukidarad-abargi, yo anmarga igar-itoge, sabsuli anmar-bibyosmalad, degi, eskaryagi anmar-metemarbalid. ¿Emide dukuakwagwa anmar-onoye sogmarde? ¡Adi suli! Igar-nabiromalad-sunnad wese anmar-onodagodo.”
Suar-ibmala gannar modapmargu, igar-nabiromaladga bela sogdapmalad, igi Pablo emarga sogsa. Roma-dulemarye wisguarmargu, nue-dobee itoarmalad.
Igar-nabiromalad, Pablo, degi, Silasse nonimarsun, ega sogdemar: “Anmar beedse begi nosmalad, degisoggu, eskaryagi-siid be nomarsun, bemar neggwebur-baidse namarsun.”
Pablo, Silas-ebo eskaryagi nosmargu, Lidia-negse nade-gusmalad. Gwenadgan-Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-daksamargu, gwenadgan-gwage nue ogannosmalad. Geb a-sorba, nade-gusmarsunnad.
